name: Foundation
description: Follow a band of exiles on their monumental journey to save humanity and rebuild civilization amid the fall of the Galactic Empire.

videos.title: The Emperor's Peace
videos.overview: Gaal Dornick leaves her life in Synnax behind when the galaxy's greatest mathematician, Hari Seldon, invites her to Trantor.

videos.title: Preparing to Live
videos.overview: The Foundation makes the long journey to Terminus as Gaal and Raych grow closer. The Empire faces a difficult decision.

videos.title: The Mathematician's Ghost
videos.overview: Brother Dusk reflects on his legacy as he prepares for ascension. The Foundation arrives on Terminus and finds a mysterious object.

videos.title: Barbarians at the Gate
videos.overview: Salvor faces off with an enemy of the Empire. Brothers Day and Dusk are at odds, while Brother Dawn wrestles with his truth.

videos.title: Upon Awakening
videos.overview: A flashback reveals the origin of Gaal’s conflict between faith and science. The standoff on Terminus takes an unfortunate turn.

videos.title: Death and the Maiden
videos.overview: Brother Day meets Zephyr Halima—a would-be leader who opposes the Empire. Brother Dusk grows suspicious of Brother Dawn.

videos.title: Mysteries and Martyrs
videos.overview: The Anacreons and their hostages board the fabled Invictus warship. The bond between Brother Dawn and Azura intesifies.

videos.title: The Missing Piece
videos.overview: Brother Day embarks on a journey that no other Cleon has ever attempted. Salvor prepares to make the ultimate sacrifice to return home.

videos.title: The First Crisis
videos.overview: On Terminus, Salvor witnesses how powerful the null field has become. Brother Dawn makes a daring choice.

videos.title: The Leap
videos.overview: An unexpected ally helps Salvor broker an alliance. A confrontation between the Brothers leads to unthinkable consequences.

videos.title: In Seldon's Shadow
videos.overview: Hari finds himself trapped in a mysterious prison. An assassination attempt leaves Day shaken. Gaal and Salvor devise an escape plan.

videos.title: A Glimpse of Darkness
videos.overview: Gaal has a disturbing vision. Day's bond with Queen Sareth grows stronger. The Vault opens and reveals a cryptic message.

videos.title: King and Commoner
videos.overview: The Empire recruits Bel Riose to investigate the resurgent Foundation. Hari leads Gaal and Salvor to a desert planet.

videos.title: Where the Stars Are Scattered Thinly
videos.overview: Queen Sareth and Dawn share a moment as she tries to learn more about Day. Brothers Constant and Poly bring Hober Mallow to Terminus.

videos.title: The Sighted and the Seen
videos.overview: Gaal, Salvor, and Hari arrive on Ignis and meet the source of the strange signal they've been tracking. Dawn and Dusk are suspicious of Day.

videos.title: Why the Gods Made Wine
videos.overview: Day and Queen Sareth make an announcement. Tellem sows seeds of distrust between Gaal and Hari. Hober Mallow reaches his destination.

videos.title: A Necessary Death
videos.overview: Salvor begins to question the Mentalics' motives. Hober Mallow’s proposal to the Spacers meets resistance. Brothers Constant and Poly stand trial.

videos.title: The Last Empress
videos.overview: Enjoiner Rue confides in Dusk about her distrust of Demerzel. Hober Mallow pulls a daring move. Day sets course for Terminus and the Foundation.

videos.title: Long Ago, Not Far Away
videos.overview: Dusk and Enjoiner Rue learn Demerzel's origin and true purpose. Tellem's plans for Gaal take a dark turn. On Terminus, Day confronts Dr. Seldon.

videos.title: Creation Myths
videos.overview: Gaal, Salvor, and Hari chart a new path forward on Ignis. Demerzel heads to Trantor, taking actions that will change Empire forever.

videos.title: A Song for the End of Everything
videos.overview: A mysterious new pirate with terrifying abilities—known as the Mule—catches the attention of the Foundation and Empire.

videos.title: Shadows in the Math
videos.overview: Gaal and Hari advance their plans on Ignis. Empire grapples with an unforeseen prediction. Pritcher enlists help to investigate the Mule.

videos.title: When a Book Finds You
videos.overview: An unexpected alliance is formed. Pritcher, Bayta, and Toran come face-to-face with the Mule. Demerzel seeks spiritual guidance.

videos.title: The Stress of Her Regard
videos.overview: Demerzel struggles with the paradox of her programming. Pritcher's true loyalties are revealed. Day sets off on a quest for answers.

videos.title: Where Tyrants Spend Eternity
videos.overview: Day enters uncharted territory. Dawn and Gaal put their plan in motion. Magnifico's worth becomes clear. Demerzel attempts to restore power.

videos.title: The Shape of Time
videos.overview: A long-awaited reunion turns violent. Day looks for Song. On New Terminus, the Vault opens—and the Mule takes aim.

videos.title: Foundation's End
videos.overview: Chaos and destruction rain down on New Terminus. Back on Trantor, Dusk and Quent unite to assess the state of the galaxy.

videos.title: Skin in the Game
videos.overview: Gaal and the Second Foundation reckon with the fall of New Terminus. Day faces judgment on Mycogen. Dusk's ascension looms.

videos.title: The Paths That Choose Us
videos.overview: Gaal confronts the power of the Mule's conversions. Dusk resorts to drastic measures. Demerzel searches for clarity about the future.

videos.title: The Darkness
videos.overview: Gaal and the Second Foundation take the fight to the Mule as Empire's legacy suffers a catastrophic blow.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 31 nominations total
